fullContent:
Asana Eladi Thailam (Oil) 
 Reference: Sahasrayogam, Taila yoga Prakarana 
 Asana Eladi Thailam is a traditional herbal oil, used in the Ayurvedic treatment of headache, ear and eye diseases. It is prepared in sesame oil base called as Asana Eladi Tailam. It is also prepared in coconut oil base, called as Asana Eladi Kera tailam / Asana Eladi coconut oil. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Asana – Pterocarpus marsupium 
 Bilvamoola – Aegle marmelos 
 Bala – Sida cordifolia 
 Guduchi – Tinospora cordifolia 
 
 These above herbs are used to prepare Kashayam (herbal decoction) 
 The following herbs are added in paste form:- 
 
 Ela – Elettaria cardamomum 
 Sthoola Ela – Amomum Subulatum 
 Turushka – Hydnocarpus laurifolia 
 Pushkaramoola – Inula racemosa 
 Phalini – Callicarpa macrophylla 
 Brahmi – Bacopa monnieri 
 Jala – Coleus zeylanicus 
 Dhyamaka – Cymbopogon martini 
 Sprukka – Adenosma indiana 
 Choraka – Curcuma zeodaria 
 Chocha – Cinnamomum zeylanicum 
 Tagara – valeriana wallichii 
 Sthouneya – Taxus baccata 
 Jati – Myristica fragrans 
 Rasa – Commiphora myrrha 
 Sukti – Ostrea edulis 
 Vyaghra – Ipomoea pestizoides 
 Surahva – Cedrus deodara 
 Ushira – Vetiveria zizanioides 
 Srivasaka – Pinus longifolia 
 Chanda – Costus speciosus 
 Guggulu – Commiphora mukul 
 Devadhoopa – Shorea robusta 
 Khapura – Boswellia serrata 
 Punnaga – Calophyllum inophyllum 
 Nagahva – Mesua ferrea 
 Saffron – Crocus sativus 
 Camphor – Cinnamomum camphora 
 Paya – Milk 
 
 How to use? 
 It is used for external application only. It is applied overhead. 
 Indications 
 
 Headache 
 Ear and eye diseases 
 Skin diseases 
 Catarrh 
 
 Side Effects 
 There are no known side effects of this oil. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
